csc_qt_attribution.instrument_title: The Clinical Safety Case Quality Tool (CSC-QT)
csc_qt_attribution.mentor_acknowledgement: The author gratefully acknowledges mentorship and clinical safety guidance from Dr Keith Grimes (Founder & CEO, Curistica Ltd; Fellow of the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Medicine & British Computer Society), co-creator with Dr Youssof Oskrochi (University College London & Head of Safety & Data Protection, Curistica Ltd) of The Clinical Safety Case Quality Tool (CSC-QT).
csc_qt_attribution.non_scoring_invariant: CSC-QT produces a structured 5-domain qualitative profile (Present / Not Present + mandatory reviewer note + domain observation). indicators.criterion_summary: Identifies clinical and non-clinical user groups and describes how each group interacts with the system.

indicators.criterion_summary: Defines affected clinical workflows, cohorts, and pathways alongside explicit exclusions and out-of-scope activities.

indicators.criterion_summary: Demonstrates structured hazard elicitation (e.g. FMEA, Bow-Tie, clinical scenario mapping, workshops) rather than ad-hoc lists.

indicators.criterion_summary: Involves clinical and operational perspectives across roles in hazard identification, risk analysis, and evaluation.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Multi-disciplinary input`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Defines each hazardous clinical situation, resulting patient harm, and contextual credibility without vague or fragmented wording.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Hazard definition clarity`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Strictly distinguishes contributing causes from clinical hazards without listing causes inside the hazard field.

indicators.criterion_summary: Enables direct relational tracing: Hazard -> Contributing Causes -> Specific Controls -> Supporting Verification Evidence.

indicators.criterion_summary: Covers all clinical workflows, user groups, and system functions defined in Domain 1 with no unaddressed scope gaps.

indicators.criterion_summary: Explains how and why specific controls change initial to residual risk, explicitly stating underlying assumptions.

indicators.criterion_summary: Identifies and consistently applies the NHS 5x5 Severity x Likelihood risk matrix and band definitions.
indicators.reviewer_note: Not Present in v0.5.0: NHS 5x5 Clinical Risk Matrix definitions were not applied.

indicators.criterion_summary: Aligns Severity ratings (1..5) with credible clinical harm and justifies worst-credible-case selection under varying circumstances.

indicators.criterion_summary: Grounds Likelihood ratings (1..5) in triggering-event frequency, user exposure, existing defences, and empirical register data.

indicators.reviewer_note: Not Present in v0.5.0: Uniform single-row table cells gave identical brief prose regardless of hazard severity.

indicators.criterion_summary: Consistently categorises controls by type (Design, Process, Training) and mechanism (Preventative, Detective, Mitigating).

indicators.criterion_summary: Avoids sole reliance on a single control or training alone for medium-or-higher severity hazards.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Control diversity`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Explicitly identifies controls transferred to deploying organisations/users, why they transfer, and implementation templates.

indicators.criterion_summary: (DCB0160 only) Assesses every transferred control locally and accepts it with implementation/monitoring evidence or alternatives.
indicators.reviewer_note: Applies strictly to DCB0160 deploying healthcare organisations (`0160 only`).

indicators.criterion_summary: Supports each control with concrete evidence of existence, effectiveness, and stated effectiveness assumptions.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Evidence provided`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Applies stronger cryptographic/empirical verification standards to critical controls mitigating high-severity hazards.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Evidence proportionality`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Includes or precisely references verifiable evidence artifacts rather than vague assertions such as 'testing was performed'.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Evidence accessibility`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Synthesises a reasoned, challengeable clinical safety conclusion for the specified shadow/commissioning context.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Safety conclusion`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Articulates clinical/population benefit and status-quo non-deployment harms to ground risk-acceptance judgement.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Clinical benefit context`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Provides explicit clinical risk/benefit rationale and reduction roadmap for any residual risk rated Undesirable (>= 8) or above.
indicators.indicator_title: Risk/benefit justification for undesirable or above hazards
indicators.reviewer_note: Not Present in v0.5.0: High-consequence residual risks lacked an explicit risk/benefit justification tied to status-quo non-deployment harm.

indicators.criterion_summary: Summarises the complete residual risk profile and highlights Undesirable-or-above hazards prominently in the CSCR.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Residual risk profile summary`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Maintains exact consistency of scope, hazard IDs, controls, and risk ratings across CSCR, CRMP, Hazard Log, and manuscript.
indicators.reviewer_note: Present in v0.5.0 manuscript/SDK (`Internal coherence`), though embedded in academic prose rather than a standalone CSCR/CRMP.

indicators.criterion_summary: Defines explicit clinical, regulatory, distributional, and technical events triggering mandatory safety-case review.
indicators.reviewer_note: Not Present in v0.5.0: Formal clinical, regulatory, and calibration-drift safety review triggers were not codified.

indicators.criterion_summary: Demonstrates active safety-case review and remediation across lifecycle iterations in response to defined triggers.
indicators.reviewer_note: Not Present in v0.5.0: No documented multi-version safety-case review trail existed prior to v0.6.0.

indicators.criterion_summary: Weaves lifecycle updates coherently across CSCR, Hazard Log, controls, evidence, and argument rather than isolated addenda.

assumptions_log.statement: Adaptive Conformal Inference (`ACI`, alpha_target = 0.10) nonconformity calibration reflects recent PCN referral-acuity distributions.

assumptions_log.statement: All ingested public datasets (NHS Digital ORD, UK OHID Fingertips, NHSBSA EPD) remain aggregate neighbourhood/practice registers with zero patient-level identifiers.

causes.description: Acute hypoxia (SpO2 < 92%) or NEWS2 >= 5 physiological instability present inside community referral payload.
Concurrent RAASi + diuretic + NSAID ('Triple-Whammy') inducing >= 25% acute eGFR drop mistaken for routine CKD review.
Uncharacterised 7-herb tea, St John's Wort, or OTC supplement modulating CYP3A4/P-gp outside mechanistic ODE priors.
Shortcut demographic/ancestry area-prior proxy used to switch antiplatelets without individual NICE DG59 CYP2C19 genotyping (`G7`).
Out-of-scope clinical query (`scope_fit_prob < 0.38`) forced into standard pathway choice set.
Memoryless plasma-only half-life assumption triggers premature Day-7 restart while hepatocyte phospholipid depot persists (`AUCR = 4.437x`, `G1`).
Upper-bound-only DDI check ignores persistent PXR nuclear-receptor hyper-clearance after rifampin cessation (`Day +7 AUCR = 0.467x`, `G4`).
Clinician or policy mistakes benign reversible Week-2 SGLT2i TGF dip (`-3.81 mL/min`) for tubular AKI and stops nephroprotection (`G8`).
Unconstrained runtime LLM/generative agent hallucinating ad-hoc slot reallocations during winter demand surges.
Two-qubit depolarising gate noise (`p2 >= 0.02`) or finite-shot variance flipping organ-comb parity decisions.
Throughput-maximising policy cherry-picking affluent low-complexity PCNs and starving Core20 neighbourhoods (`G6`).
Premature argmax collapse of ambiguous Core20 referral onto group rehab prior to warm-home/interpreter welfare resolution (`G2`).

hazards.hazardous_situation: A clinically unstable patient (e.g. acute hypoxia SpO2 < 92%, sepsis NEWS2 >= 5, chest pain, or acute >= 25% Triple-Whammy eGFR drop) is routed into routine asynchronous neighbourhood commissioning or social-prescribing workflow instead of immediate urgent care.
hazards.initial_justification: Catastrophic harm (Severity = 5) is credible if acute cardiorespiratory/septic deterioration is queued into routine community review; Medium initial likelihood (Likelihood = 3, Score = 15 Unacceptable) reflects mixed-acuity primary care winter referral streams.
hazards.potential_clinical_harm: Delayed emergency resuscitation, irreversible acute kidney injury, septic shock progression, or preventable patient death.
hazards.residual_justification: Severity remains Catastrophic (5) because physiological harm if missed is unchanged, but deterministic 0.001 ms `DCB0129Guard.evaluate_pre_rollout` (`urgent_prob >= 0.25` -> `0L` hard block `K-OCQ-01a`), Triple-Whammy AKI flag (`K-OCQ-01b`), and local 999/duty-GP SOP (`K-OCQ-01c`) reduce likelihood to Very Low (1), lowering risk from 15 (Unacceptable) to 5 (Tolerable).

hazards.hazardous_situation: Commissioning or shadow SMR analytics recommend antiplatelet, statin, or DOAC regimen selection in cohorts with uncharacterised botanical/OTC metabolic modulators or ungenotyped CYP2C19 / SLCO1B1 variation.
hazards.initial_justification: Major harm (Severity = 4: disabling stroke, major GI/intracranial haemorrhage, or rhabdomyolysis) paired with High initial likelihood (Likelihood = 4, Score = 16 Unacceptable) given ~28-58% multi-ethnic CYP2C19 LOF prevalence and widespread OTC/herbal use.
hazards.potential_clinical_harm: Secondary ischaemic stroke from clopidogrel bioactivation failure in CYP2C19 loss-of-function carriers, major bleeding from unnecessary potent P2Y12 switching in false-positive normal metabolizers (71.5% ancestry-proxy error), or severe statin myopathy.
hazards.residual_justification: Tier-1 `SNOMED 315594003` herbal abstention gate (`K-OCQ-02a`), Anti-Goodhart Gate `G7` blocking ungenotyped demographic/ancestry proxy shortcuts (`K-OCQ-02b`), dynamic mid-circuit NICE DG59 VOI staging (`K-OCQ-02c`), and transferred local Pharmacist SMR + POCT genotyping SOP (`K-OCQ-02d`) reduce likelihood from High (4) to Low (2; Score = 8 Undesirable) under Assumptions `A-OCQ-01` & `A-OCQ-03`.
hazards.undesirable_risk_benefit_argument: Residual risk is 8 (Undesirable) because Major clinical severity (4) is inherent to secondary stroke/bleed prevention and biological POCT execution resides with local NHS clinicians (`TC-OCQ-02`). Retaining shadow VOI analytics is strongly justified against status-quo non-deployment, which leaves 2,240.5 preventable strokes/yr unaddressed across England's 42 ICBs (`b990361d`).
hazards.workflow_scope: Layer 0/2 Structured Medication Review (SMR) & NICE DG59 Pharmacogenomic Pathway

hazards.initial_justification: Major harm (Severity = 4: thromboembolism, major haemorrhage, or irreversible renal progression) and High initial likelihood (Likelihood = 4, Score = 16 Unacceptable) because plasma-only Markovian calculators miss intracellular hepatocyte depots by +46.71 pp (`50a5e601`) and reactive SGLT2i dip-stopping is common in routine practice.
hazards.potential_clinical_harm: Supratherapeutic statin/DOAC overdose toxicity (Day-7 AUCR 4.437x), sub-therapeutic DOAC thromboembolic stroke during post-rifampin PXR tail (AUCR 0.467x < 0.50x), or accelerated ESKD dialysis progression from premature SGLT2i cessation.
hazards.residual_justification: Zero-fit 9-state RK4 bidirectional [0.50x, 2.00x] guard (`GMFE = 1.2423`, `K-OCQ-03a`), Starling glomerular TGF-vs-AKI discriminator + Gate `G8` (`GMFE = 1.0701`, `K-OCQ-03b`), `--commit-gate` policy admission blocker (`K-OCQ-03c`), and transferred BNF/SmPC/KDIGO prescriber verification (`K-OCQ-03d`) reduce likelihood from 4 to 2 (Score = 8 Undesirable) under `A-OCQ-04`.

Clinical benefit outweighs residual shadow risk: coupled washout + SGLT2i preservation avoids 2,115.9 major bleeds/yr, 2,529.6 AKI admissions/yr, and 18,741.7 ESKD dialysis patient-years over 10 years (`51ae0545`).
